snippet.title: Fame or Folly | Announcement Trailer (Roguelike Deckbuilder)
snippet.description:
Travel the realm. Win the crowd. Meet the King.
👇 WISHLIST THE GAME 👇
https://fameorfolly.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=official_trailer

Fame or Folly is the deckbuilder of deckbuilders. Set in an alternative-history Renaissance empire, conflicts are settled on the stage, not the battlefield.

What makes it unique?
Every turn is pure deckbuilding strategy. You are constantly managing your roster size and card quality, pivoting your build instantly based on what the shop offers. Draft smart, fire often, and don't get attached to your cards.

Key Features:

TroupeCraft: Synergy between 5 classes (Minstrels, Vendors, Mystics, Outcasts, Wardens).

The Stage: Manage tension before the crowd riots.

150+ Troupers: Every performer brings unique subtext and abilities.

The Stakes: Win the Grand Festival or face the folly of the crowd.

Join the Community:
https://fameorfolly.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=official_trailer

#FameOrFolly #NewIndieGame #RoguelikeDeckbuilder #StrategyGame #Steam #balatro #deckbuilder #gaming #gamers
